expected.fmt:
import expect_true from "@std/test/test.ms"

fn fresh() List[Int]:
	return [1, 2, 3]

test "literals":
	var a = fresh()
	b := fresh()
	a.append(value: 4)
	expect_true((a.length() == 4 and b.length() == 3))?

	var floats = [1.5, 2.5]
	flags := [true, false, true]
	var words = ["a", "b"]
	empty := List[Int]()
	expect_true(
		(
			floats.length() == 2
			and flags.length() == 3
			and words.length() == 2
			and empty.is_empty()
		)
	)?
	floats.append(value: 3.5)
	words.append(value: "c")
	expect_true((floats.get(index: 2) == 3.5 and words.get(index: 2) == "c"))?
	expect_true(([1, 2] == [1, 2] and not ([1, 2] == [2, 1])))?

	rows := [[1], [2, 3]]
	expect_true((rows.get(index: 1) == [2, 3]))?
